description: This file handles post-installation tasks for bundled plugins in an OpenClaw project. It performs dependency resolution, environment setup, and executes npm installs for missing runtime dependencies of bundled plugins.

methods.name: readJson
methods.description: Reads and parses a JSON file from the specified path.

methods.name: dependencySentinelPath
methods.description: Constructs the path to a package's sentinel JSON within node_modules.

methods.name: collectRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Combines dependencies and optionalDependencies from a package.json object.

methods.name: discoverBundledPluginRuntimeDeps
methods.description: Discovers runtime dependencies of bundled plugins by scanning the extensions directory.

methods.name: createNestedNpmInstallEnv
methods.description: Creates an environment object for nested npm installs, removing global/local configs.

methods.name: isSourceCheckoutRoot
methods.description: Determines if the current directory is the root of a source checkout based on presence of common files/directories.

methods.name: shouldRunBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Checks whether postinstall script should execute, based on environment variables and directory state.

methods.name: runBundledPluginPostinstall
methods.description: Main function that runs the postinstall process, installing missing dependencies.
